lines.text: This is Sitka. Strong, light, and it bends without breaking.
lines.spoken: This is, Sitka,. Strong, light, and it bends without breaking.

lines.text: Sit down anywhere, and a light pole under each hip takes most of your weight. A carbon spring at each knee catches you.

lines.text: Sitka is completely open. The design, the math, every part. Come build one with us.
